newsitem.title: USA: Quezon Power files for $203.3 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Quezon Power files for $203.3 mln in bonds.

text.p: Quezon Power (Philippines) Ltd Co filed Wednesday a shelf registration with U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $203.3 million in senior secured bonds due 2017.
The offering will be managed by Salomon Brothers Inc and UBS Securities LLC, according to the filing.

Proceeds will be used to pay project costs and to make a special distribution to the owers to enable them to repay all or a portion of their reimbursement obligations in respect to the equity contribution letters of credit, the filing said.

Quezon, based in Mauban, Quezon, is a Philippines limited partnerhip formed in late 1996 for the purpose of developing, constructing, owing, operating and maintaining a coal-fired power generation facility and 31-kilometer transmission line.
